section.codeblock:
Configure the Database Connection Set up the connection between the application and your database server.

Ensure you have database administrator credentials.

The application requires a database connection for data persistence.

 Open the configuration file. The file is located /etc/app/config.xml. Enter the database hostname. The application validates the connection.

The database connection is configured and active.

Restart the application to apply changes.
section.p:
The nesting is strict and meaningful:
<taskbody> contains the procedural content
<prereq> contains the prerequisites needed to start the task
<steps> contains individual <step>elements
Each <step> contains a <cmd> and optional supporting elements
<result> contains the result of performing the task
<postreq> contains the postrequisites needed after the task is completed
Publishing systems rely on this structure to format content correctly. AI systems use it to interpret relationships between actions, instructions, and outcomes.
